visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with several indigenous people in Papua New Guinea wearing traditional skeleton-themed body paint and headgear. A female vlogger in a yellow and red shirt interacts with a large crowd of local residents outdoors in bright daylight. The scene then transitions to a market setting where betel nuts are being sold through a metal cage. (2) At night, the vlogger walks through a dense forest illuminated by a flashlight. The scene shifts to daytime at an airport, showing an Air Niugini aircraft on the tarmac and the vlogger at a check-in counter with staff and luggage in the background. (3) The vlogger is seen in the back of a car and on a plane, wearing sunglasses and showing close-ups of her facial skin texture. A rapid montage follows, showing her in various global locations: snowy landscapes (Antarctica/Norway), deserts (Africa), and grassy fields with children. (4) The setting changes to a well-lit indoor hotel room. The vlogger holds several jars of skincare products branded as '23.5°N'. She demonstrates the product application, using a small spatula to apply clear and white gels to her face and forehead. The video concludes with her in traditional indigenous face paint while holding the product box in a car.
